# `shell/gpu-ui/GPUUICompositor.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/shell/gpu-ui/GPUUICompositor.js`

GPUUICompositor.js — Level-4 GPU-native UI compositor (3D by default). Renders the desktop's windows as tinted textured quads in a real perspective scene on a full-screen WebGPU canvas. There is NO DOM in this path: text is rasterized into a glyph atlas (GPUTextRenderer) and everything — window surfaces, titlebars, glyphs — is one unified quad primitive. Camera: a perspective camera placed on +Z at d = (vpH/2)/tan(fov/2) so the z=0 plane maps 1:1 to CSS pixels. A window at z=0 with no tilt is therefore pixel-perfect and fully usable, yet it's a genuine 3D quad — depth (z) and tilt are first-class, focused windows come forward, and a subtle pointer parallax sells the 3D space. Coordinate spaces: - window-local px: origin top-left, +x right, +y down (what widgets author) - world units == CSS px, origin = viewport center, +Y up, desktop on z=0 - per-window model matrix maps local px → world (bakes centering + Y-flip) Transparency uses painter's order (windows sorted far→near, widgets in emit order) so there is no depth buffer and no coplanar z-fighting. Engine tech reused (no duplication): VirtualGPU (owner-scoped lease), VGPUTextureAtlas (glyph/solid atlas), engine/core/math (camera + unproject).

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
